# Cross Road Launcher Recovery 2.1.1 - Preview

Manual recovery for an existing Cross Road/Kingdom Hearts UX + Dark Road installation. **Supports installed Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge.** This is a prerelease; stable downloads and the stable update channel are unchanged.

## Recovery steps

1. Close the game and fully exit its dedicated browser profile.
2. Download `CrossRoad-Launcher-Recovery-2.1.1-preview.zip` and extract all files.
3. Run `REPAIR LAUNCHER.cmd` and select your existing game folder containing `v1/index.html` and `Content`. Do not select the extracted recovery package or a browser-profile directory.
4. Open the game's desktop shortcut. Play does not require an update or a restore. If Play fails, copy the full error and selected installation shown in the details area.

Recovery installs the launcher side by side, verifies and backs up the previous app files, and preserves the game URL, runtime, owned Content, `GameProfile`, `EdgeGameProfile`, browser choice and saves. It does not launch the game, install a browser, migrate saves or change browser security settings. Downgrades, modified app files and invalid installation roots are rejected. Keep your private backups.

## Browser behavior

Chrome and Edge detection covers standard 64-bit/32-bit system folders, per-user installations and registered App Paths. Installed executables must have the correct product identity and valid Google/Microsoft signatures, and must be new enough for the selected saved profile. Existing compatible bundled Chrome remains available for legacy Chrome profiles.

An explicit Chrome choice cannot silently fall back to Edge, and an explicit Edge choice cannot silently fall back to Chrome. An existing sole browser profile is retained even when a choice file is absent. If both saved profiles exist without a saved choice, the launcher stops for an explicit original-browser selection rather than opening a different save. Fresh installations may use Chrome or Edge. The recovery does not force Edge.

## Fixes and verification

Fixes the manual preview-upgrade dead end, secondary-shortcut retry, stale rollback eligibility, misleading preview/stable messages, clipped Play errors and two browser-selection cases that could choose a different profile. Restore is available only after a completed in-app update for the installed version; the initial bootstrap/manual launcher recovery does not create a full app/runtime update to undo.

109 isolated checks passed: 49 updater, nine bootstrap, 21 recovery/launch and 30 browser-detection/selection checks, plus UI error rendering and actual published-Preview-1 package recovery integration. Chrome and Edge system/per-user/custom registry paths and browser metadata/signatures were simulated in the matrix; process launch was replaced with a capture callback. Read-only detection of a real signed Microsoft Edge installation at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe` also succeeded (155.0.4283.45). Installed Chrome was not present on the test host, so no live installed-Chrome execution is claimed. No game or browser was launched during this recovery audit.

**The reported Play failure remains undiagnosed.** Their screenshot shows a stable-channel check, not a Play error; it does not establish that Edge caused the failure. This preview fixes verified recovery and browser-selection defects but does not claim their launch problem is resolved. Visual in-game save confirmation and fresh installation remain unverified.

The updater still uses `releases/latest` and numeric stable tags. It does not automatically offer this prerelease; use the manual recovery ZIP. `CrossRoad-Update.zip`/`.json` are publisher payloads, not files to copy over saves manually. The package's staged/local-preview labels record build provenance. All public downloads are checked against `SHA256SUMS.txt` and GitHub SHA256 asset metadata by the release workflow.

No audio experiment, browser binaries, game assets, profiles, saves, screenshots or private logs are included.
